import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strong features based on t-statistics
    t_stats = [abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)], 
                                   feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)], 
                                   equal_var=False)[0]) 
               for fid in feats.ids]
    
    # Sort by t-statistic (descending)
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1]
    strong_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:20]]
    
    # Find correlated pairs with |r| >= 0.6
    corr_pairs = []
    for i in range(len(strong_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(strong_features)):
            fid1, fid2 = strong_features[i], strong_features[j]
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid1)], 
                               feats.x[:, feats.column(fid2)])[0,1]) >= 0.6:
                corr_pairs.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Cluster correlated features using Agglomerative Clustering
    if corr_pairs:
        all_features = set()
        for a, b in corr_pairs:
            all_features.add(a)
            all_features.add(b)
        
        # Build similarity matrix for clustering
        feature_list = list(all_features)
        n_features = len(feature_list)
        sim_matrix = np.zeros((n_features, n_features))
        
        for i in range(n_features):
            for j in range(i+1, n_features):
                fid1, fid2 = feature_list[i], feature_list[j]
                corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid1)], 
                                   feats.x[:, feats.column(fid2)])[0,1]
                sim_matrix[i,j] = sim_matrix[j,i] = abs(corr)
        
        # Hierarchical clustering
        clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=None, 
                                           distance_threshold=0.6,
                                           linkage='average')
        clusters = clustering.fit_predict(1-sim_matrix)
        
        # Select representative feature from each cluster (highest t-statistic)
        cluster_representatives = {}
        for i, cluster_id in enumerate(clusters):
            fid = feature_list[i]
            t_stat = t_stats[feats.ids.index(fid)]
            if cluster_id not in cluster_representatives or \
               t_stat > cluster_representatives[cluster_id][1]:
                cluster_representatives[cluster_id] = (fid, t_stat)
        
        # Drivers are the representatives
        drivers = tuple([fid for fid, _ in cluster_representatives.values()])
    else:
        # No strong correlations, just use top features
        drivers = tuple([feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:min(MAX_DRIVERS, len(feats.ids))]])
    
    # Columns are all features used in the model
    columns = feats.ids
    
    # Products are pairs of correlated features (for interaction terms)
    products = tuple(corr_pairs) if corr_pairs else ()
    
    # Loadings are weights based on t-statistics
    loadings = {fid: t_stats[feats.ids.index(fid)] 
                for fid in feats.ids}
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
